stem.en: Why is a combined-cycle power plant's overall efficiency less than the simple sum of its topping and bottoming cycles' individual efficiencies?
stem.et: Miks on kombitsükliga elektrijaama üldine kasutegur väiksem kui tema ülemise ja alumise tsükli üksikute kasutegurite lihtne summa?

label.en: Because the bottoming cycle can only act on the fraction of heat the topping cycle didn't already convert to work, so its contribution is η_bottoming×(1−η_topping), not the full η_bottoming.
label.et: Sest alumine tsükkel saab toimida ainult sellel osal soojusest, mida ülemine tsükkel juba tööks ei muutnud, seega on tema panus η_alumine×(1−η_ülemine), mitte täielik η_alumine.

label.en: It isn't -- the overall efficiency is exactly the sum of the two cycles' individual efficiencies, since each cycle contributes independently.
label.et: See ei ole nii -- üldine kasutegur on täpselt kahe tsükli üksikute kasutegurite summa, kuna kumbki tsükkel annab oma panuse sõltumatult.

label.en: Because energy is destroyed as it passes from the topping cycle to the bottoming cycle, so less total energy is available to compute an efficiency from.
label.et: Sest energia hävib, kui see liigub ülemiselt tsüklilt alumisele, mistõttu on kasuteguri arvutamiseks vähem koguenergiat saadaval.

label.en: Because the exhaust heat handed to the bottoming cycle is already too low in raw energy content to contribute meaningfully, regardless of its temperature.
label.et: Sest alumisele tsüklile antav heitsoojus on juba liiga madala toorenergiasisaldusega, et anda arvestatavat panust, sõltumata selle temperatuurist.
